createMarket.heading: Create a Market
createMarket.description: Propose a new binary or multiple-choice market for admin review.
createMarket.proposalCostDesc: This amount is deducted when you create the proposal. If an admin rejects the proposal, the proposal cost is refunded.
createMarket.groupCostDesc: Initial multiple-choice answers are included in the group proposal cost. Later answer additions cost {{cost}} credits each if enabled.
createMarket.marketTypeDesc: Multiple-choice binary groups create one parent page and a normal YES/NO child market for each answer.
createMarket.multipleChoiceGroupDesc: Each answer becomes its own YES/NO market. Initial answers do not add proposal cost.
createMarket.marketTagsDesc: Pick up to five categories so admins can review routing and users can find this market.
createMarket.maxTagsError: You can select up to five market tags.
createMarket.yesLabelDesc: Custom label for positive outcome (defaults to "YES")
createMarket.noLabelDesc: Custom label for negative outcome (defaults to "NO")
createMarket.answerOptionsDesc: Each answer becomes a separate YES/NO child market under one parent page.
createMarket.largeAnswerWarning: Large answer sets can be harder for participants to compare. Initial answers are still included in the group proposal cost.
createMarket.maxAnswersError: Multiple-choice market groups can have up to {{max}} answers.
createMarket.minAnswersError: Add at least two answer options.
createMarket.labelTooLong: Answer labels must be 160 characters or fewer.
createMarket.autoApproveDesc: If enabled, active moderators can add later answer options immediately. If disabled, their options wait for your approval.
createMarket.proposedNotTradable: This moderator-mode proposal is not tradable until an admin approves it. You will be redirected to your Proposed Markets tab.
createMarket.yesLabelError: Yes label must be between 1 and 20 characters
createMarket.noLabelError: No label must be between 1 and 20 characters
createMarket.creationFailed: Market creation failed. Please try again.

governance.autoApproveProposalsDesc: When enabled, new moderator-created proposals become published and tradable immediately.
governance.autoApproveAmendmentsDesc: When enabled, newly proposed steward amendments are immediately accepted.
governance.answerOptionApprovalPolicyDesc: Controls what happens when active moderators add answer options to grouped markets.
governance.policyAutoDesc: Every active moderator answer option is immediately added to its grouped market.
governance.policyModeratorTitle: Let the steward choose per market
governance.policyModeratorDesc: Default. The grouped market steward controls auto-approval with the toggle on that market page.
governance.policyAdminDesc: Answer options from other moderators stay pending for admin review, regardless of the steward toggle.

tags.title: Market Tags
tags.tagsDescription: Admins define the tag vocabulary. Moderators can attach active tags during market creation; admins can review those tags before publication.
tags.deactivateNote: Deactivating a tag does not remove it from existing markets. It only prevents new assignments until reactivated.
tags.inactiveNote: Inactive — cannot be newly assigned until reactivated.
tags.noTags: No tags have been created yet.
tags.deactivateConfirm:
Deactivate "{{name}}"?

It will stay visible on markets but cannot be newly assigned until reactivated.

setupConfig.title: Setup Configuration
setupConfig.description: These are the platform's economic configuration parameters. They control market creation costs, initial balances, fees, and other financial settings.

explanations.initialMarketProbability: Default probability percentage for new markets when first created
explanations.initialMarketSubsidization: Initial funding provided to new markets to bootstrap liquidity

explanations.initialMarketNo: Starting number of NO shares available in new markets
explanations.createMarketCost: Cost in points for users to create a new prediction market
explanations.traderBonus: Bonus points awarded to users for participating in trading
explanations.initialAccountBalance: Starting balance given to new user accounts
explanations.maximumDebtAllowed: Maximum negative balance users can reach before restrictions
explanations.minimumBet: Smallest bet amount allowed on any market
explanations.maxDustPerSale: Maximum dust (small remainder) allowed when selling positions
explanations.initialBetFee: Fee charged when placing the first bet on a market
explanations.buySharesFee: Fee charged when purchasing shares in a market
explanations.sellSharesFee: Fee charged when selling shares back to the market
